entries.question: Who dies most often on each boss?
entries.normalized_question: who dies most often on each boss
entries.sql:
WITH latest_zone AS (
  SELECT zone_name
  FROM 03_gold.sc_analytics.gold_player_death_events
  WHERE boss_name IS NOT NULL
    AND zone_name IS NOT NULL
    AND raid_night_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zone_name
  ORDER BY MAX(raid_night_date) DESC
  LIMIT 1
), boss_difficulty_scope AS (
  SELECT
    d.zone_name,
    d.boss_name,
    MAX(d.difficulty) AS difficulty
  FROM 03_gold.sc_analytics.gold_player_death_events AS d
  INNER JOIN latest_zone AS z
    ON d.zone_name = z.zone_name
  WHERE d.boss_name IS NOT NULL
    AND d.difficulty IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.zone_name, d.boss_name
), death_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.zone_name,
    d.boss_name,
    d.difficulty_label,
    d.player_name,
    d.player_class,
    COUNT(*) AS death_count,
    MAX(d.raid_night_date) AS last_death_date
  FROM 03_gold.sc_analytics.gold_player_death_events AS d
  INNER JOIN boss_difficulty_scope AS scope
    ON d.zone_name = scope.zone_name
   AND d.boss_name = scope.boss_name
   AND d.difficulty = scope.difficulty
  GROUP BY
    d.zone_name,
    d.boss_name,
    d.difficulty_label,
    d.player_name,
    d.player_class
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY zone_name, boss_name, difficulty_label
      ORDER BY death_count DESC, player_name ASC
    ) AS death_rank
  FROM death_counts
)
SELECT
  zone_name,
  boss_name,
  difficulty_label,
  player_name,
  player_class,
  death_count,
  last_death_date
FROM ranked
WHERE death_rank = 1
ORDER BY boss_name ASC
LIMIT 500
entries.notes: Teaches the LLM that boss-scoped death-leader questions must use gold_player_death_events and rank death_count within each boss.
